data.title: One Piece of meat
data.solution:
import sys
import math

m = int(input())
k = int(input())
c = int(input())
t = int(input())

# Calculate days, rounding up for any partial days
days_needed = math.ceil(k / c)
meat_needed = days_needed * m

if t >= meat_needed:
    print("SHISHISHI")
else:
    print("I'm hungry Sandy")
data.statement:
Champanzee D. Lucy is a very hungry pirate. He needs to eat exactly [[m]]-kg of meat per day to survive.

His ship is currently sailing to the next island, which is [[k]]-km away. The ship travels at a constant speed of [[c]]-km per day.

You are given the total amount of meat [[t]]-kg currently available on the ship. Determine if there is enough meat to sustain Lucy until the ship arrives at the island.

Note: The ship arrives instantly at the end of the calculated days. If the travel time is a fraction, Lucy still needs to eat for the full fractional day (for example, a 1.2 day trip requires 2 full days of meat).
data.constraints:
1 <= m <= 1000
1 <= k <= 1000
1 <= d <= 1000
1 <= t <= 1000
all inputs are positive integers

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Champanzee D. Lucy is a very hungry pirate. He needs to eat exactly m-kg of meat per day to survive.

His ship is currently sailing to the next island, which is k-km away. The ship travels at a constant speed of c-km per day.

You are given the total amount of meat t-kg currently available on the ship. Determine if there is enough meat to sustain Lucy until the ship arrives at the island.

Note: The ship arrives instantly at the end of the calculated days. If the travel time is a fraction, Lucy still needs to eat for the full fractional day (for example, a 1.2 day trip requires 2 full days of meat).
Input
Line 1: m — The meat Lucy eats per day (in kg).
Line 2: k — The distance to the next island (in km).
Line 3: d — The distance the ship travels per day (in km).
Line 4: t — The total meat currently on the ship (in kg).
Output
A single line: "SHISHISHI" if there is enough meat or "I'm hungry Sandy" if the meat runs out before arrival.
Constraints
1 <= m <= 1000
1 <= k <= 1000
1 <= d <= 1000
1 <= t <= 1000
all inputs are positive integers
Example
Input
5
100
50
20
Output
SHISHISHI
